description: The line plot illustrates the performance of different fine-tuning configurations for the Whisper model, specifically for the "tiny" variant, across six epochs, with the metric measured as Word Error Rate (WER). The x-axis represents the epoch number, ranging from 0 to 6, while the y-axis shows the WER, which decreases from approximately 70 to below 40. Four distinct configurations are compared: "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" (solid line with circles), "tiny AdaLoRA_int8" (dashed line with squares), "tiny int4" (dotted line with circles), and "tiny full" (dotted line with triangles). All four lines show a general downward trend in WER as the number of epochs increases. At epoch 0, the "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" and "tiny AdaLoRA_int8" models start with the highest WER, around 70, while "tiny int4" and "tiny full" start at approximately 60 and 30, respectively. By epoch 6, the "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" and "tiny AdaLoRA_int8" models converge to a WER of about 35, while "tiny int4" and "tiny full" stabilize at around 40 and 30, respectively. The "tiny full" model consistently maintains the lowest WER throughout the training process.
